invariants.rationale: instantTime typically represents a commit timestamp and should be non-null and non-empty for meaningful bulk insert operations.
A bulk insert operation should have at least one record to insert.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is required to perform any operations during bulk insert.
Option<BulkInsertPartitioner> argument should be non-null to check for partitioning strategies even if it might be empty.
If hoodieRecords is non-null, all contained HoodieRecord<T> elements should also be non-null for proper processing.
